subject: Skyline: PO metadata, remit instructions, and self-billing checklist
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@skyline-retail.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@skyline-retail.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 08:03:00 +0100
Subject: Supplier setup + PO / VAT handling questions

Hi Rachel —

Thanks for the demo last week. We're ready to move Redwood through our supplier onboarding so we can issue POs to you. Before we create the supplier record in our portal, can you confirm the following items so our AP team has everything they need?

1) Legal entity name and registered address to appear on invoices
2) VAT / tax identifiers for EU billing (VAT ID and any reverse-charge guidance)
3) Bank remit instructions (IBAN / BIC) and whether you accept EUR/GBP/USD
4) Do you expect Skyline to self-bill (we have a self-billing program for a subset of vendors)? If yes, we need a signed self-billing agreement and a template invoice to validate fields
5) Preferred invoice format (PDF + line-item CSV, or PDF only) and whether the PO number must be embedded in the invoice PDF body or can appear in the email subject
6) Any special invoice matching rules we should set in our ERP (2-way vs 3-way matching; mandatory PO line unit prices)

I attached the supplier creation checklist we use on our side — if you can get the items above back to me by EOD Friday we can have the Skyline supplier record created next week.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Procurement Manager | Skyline Retail
samantha.lee@skyline-retail.com

Attachment: supplier_onboarding_checklist.pdf (1 page)

Appreciate the checklist. Quick answers below and I've looped in our finance lead (Naomi) and sales ops (Ben) to add the technical/output pieces:

1) Legal entity: Redwood Inference, Inc. (US parent)
   Registered address for invoices: 450 Market St, Suite 1200, San Francisco, CA 94105, USA
2) VAT / tax: We are VAT-registered in the EU under GB999999973 (EU setup varies by entity — see Naomi's note)
3) Bank remit: IBAN: GB11RBOS12345612345678 | BIC: RBOSGB2L — we accept EUR and USD; GBP by prior arrangement
4) Self-billing: We are open to self-billing for Skyline but require a signed self-billing agreement. Naomi will provide the self-billing certificate and required fields.
5) Invoice format: PDF invoice is standard; we can provide a line-item CSV on request. Please confirm whether you require PO number in the invoice PDF body (recommended) and we will also place PO in the invoice filename and email subject.

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 13:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Supplier setup + PO / VAT handling questions

Hi all —

Thanks Rachel. Quick finance notes for Skyline so onboarding is smooth:

• EU VAT handling: If Skyline will apply reverse-charge for services, Redwood requires the invoice to show the customer's VAT ID and a reverse-charge reference ("VAT reverse charge — Article 44/196") on each invoice line. We can issue invoices from our UK entity or US parent depending on contract — please confirm which legal entity you will create as the supplier in your portal.

• Self-billing: We can participate in self-billing. Required items for our self-billing agreement: signed self-billing mandate (Skyline signature), sample monthly remittance report format, and confirmation of payment terms (Net 45 by default, Net 30 by exception). When self-billing is active, Skyline must send a monthly remittance confirmation email to ap-payments@redwood.com with payment references.

• Invoice metadata (required fields to avoid payment delay):
  - PO number (mandatory)
  - Invoice number (unique)
  - Invoice date
  - Currency
  - Line-item descriptions with unit price and qty (if 2-way matching is used, line items optional; for 3-way matching provide full PO line IDs)
  - Customer VAT ID
  - Supplier VAT ID
  - Bank details (IBAN / BIC)

• Bank details (repeated for clarity):
  - Account name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
  - IBAN: GB11RBOS12345612345678
  - BIC: RBOSGB2L

I attached a sample invoice showing the exact field layout we recommend (Sample_Invoice_Redwood.pdf). If Skyline requires 3-way matching, please send a sample PO XML/CSV so we can confirm mapping.

Thanks — I can sign the self-billing mandate once Skyline shares your template.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Finance | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com

Attachment: Sample_Invoice_Redwood.pdf

Hi Rachel / team —

This is perfect, thank you. A few confirmations from our side:

• Skyline will enable 2-way invoice matching for Redwood (PO + invoice). We will only move to 3-way if the PO contains explicit goods receipt information.
• We can accept PDF invoices with PO printed on the first page; please also include PO in the email subject.
• Self-billing: we'll send our standard self-billing mandate (attached in a separate email later today). Once signed, we will enable the self-billing flag in the portal and share the remittance format.
• Supplier code: please limit to 12 alphanumeric characters — we will generate the supplier code when we create the record.

Could you send one sample invoice (PDF) with the fields Naomi requested so we can validate the portal ingestion? If everything looks good we'll create the supplier record and issue the first PO next week.

Best regards,
Samantha Lee
